firmware.notes: Encrypted link with the board's PIN, in-app updates with automatic rollback, ADC offset calibration at every run.
Safe mode after repeated crashes; evenly spaced sampling by default (25 % less noise); fixed: CA with bursts ran 4 % fast.

app.notes: Fix: a run is saved even when another tab is open when it ends (runs could be lost if you left the Run screen during a run).

firmware.notes: 1.17.0 beta: a run survives a dropped Bluetooth link (journal + resume); health record; SWV clip flags (1.16.0).
Board log over BLE: the board's own messages, kept across a crash, readable in the app (Device -> Board log, app >= 1.19.0) and included in every problem report.
1.19.0: the board applies its potential calibration (SOP test A, app 1.21.0) to every potential step.
1.19.1: holds the 32 MHz crystal during every measurement, so step and sample timing (scan rate, SWV frequency, mains-rejection window) is crystal-accurate on every board.

1.19.2: no ADC offset re-calibration at every run start. Repeat runs no longer jump by up to 0.6 % (0.17 uA on 20 kOhm). After installing, redo the zero calibration (open circuit) and then the gain calibration.

1.19.3: the board log records the nRF52840 VBUS detector at boot and on every change. On V1.2 the cell is on VBUS; MSTAT-02 measured 3.75 V threshold (about half charge), the base for the low-battery warning. Measurements unchanged from 1.19.2.

1.19.4: SWV at 50-300 Hz no longer reads low. One stale ADC conversion of the previous half-period landed at the start of every averaging window (100 Hz: -1.3 %, 10 Hz: -0.2 %). Now 100/10 Hz = 0.999 on a resistor. DPV +0.1 %; CA, CV unchanged. Calibrations are kept.
SWV/CV/DPV step timing on a hardware step clock: SWV 100 Hz now runs at 100.0 Hz (was 97.0 Hz); 100/10 Hz amplitude ratio 1.001 on 100 kOhm
Hotfix for 1.19.5: the step clock is stopped after each run, so an idle board draws ~45 uA again (1.19.5: 363 uA after its first run until a reboot)

1.20.0: battery estimate. The board counts the charge it uses (V1 boards cannot measure their cell) and asks the app after a battery change whether the cell is full; app 1.21.6 shows the percent and warns below 25 %. Below 15 % the board refuses new runs; at 10 % it stops and switches itself off (reconnect the battery after charging). Includes the 1.19.6 idle-current fix and the 1.19.5 step clock.

1.20.2: SWV reads the last half of each half-period when a mains cycle would start in its first half (above 15 Hz at 60 Hz mains, 12.5 Hz at 50 Hz). At 25 Hz the old window began 3.3 ms after each potential jump and read the charging current: background 10-58 uA and peaks ~22 % high against the PalmSens; now 2.8 uA and within 1 % (MSTAT-02, same drop). 1x oversampling reads at the end of the step. Includes 1.20.1: an updated image confirms itself only after the app reads its image state (needs app >= 1.21.7; with an older app the board returns to the previous firmware on the next reset). Verified on MSTAT-TEST 25 Oct.

app.notes: 1.21.7: needed before firmware 1.20.1. After an update, and when it finds a board on an unconfirmed image, the app reads the image state, which is what lets firmware 1.20.1 confirm itself (older apps leave it to roll back). Lab dashboard: uploads of runs deleted on the tablet are dropped instead of showing as 'refused'; Send now clears old ones.
